errors.text: The proposed Mg-Al-Cr transient eutectic mechanism is not supported by the cited evidence or a phase diagram; at 875 °C Mg-rich material is already above the melting point of Mg, so bulk liquid formation and Mg loss cannot be treated as a narrowly controlled transient eutectic.
No overall composition or calculated density is provided, and the use of dense Nb means compliance with the required density below 6 g/cm³ is not demonstrated.
Formation of a protective Cr2O3/Al2O3 scale during SPS under Ar with less than 10 ppm oxygen is internally inconsistent and is not evidenced for this Mg-Nb-Ti-Cr-Al system.
The experiment omits the required corrosion comparison in 3.5 wt% NaCl and uses oxidation at 800 °C rather than the target 900 °C condition.
